 Follow Teri Polo showcases major transformation 26 years after Meet the Parents as fans say the same thing
 Hannah Hargrave Thu, November 12, 2026 at 12:54 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Teri Polo shows off her wavy hair (Getty Images) Teri Polo  looked sensational when she debuted a striking new look on the red carpet on November 11 more than a quarter of a century after winning over audiences in Meet the Parents.
 The 57-year-old star stepped out for the Focker-in-Law world premiere in New York, and showed off her curves in a sleek, figure-hugging, black midi dress.
 Teri turned heads with her confidence and effortlessly chic ensemble. She paired her outfit with a classic black-and-gold clutch and subtle statement rings.
 Ben Stiller and Teri Polo in a scene from Meet the Parents (@ Getty Images)
 Her tailored silhouette highlighted her figure and showcased her edgy forearm tattoos. Photos and videos shared on social media earned her praise from fans who loved her "womanly" body and head-to-toe look.  
 Teri's youthful makeover
 Teri showed off her makeover on the red carpet (@ Getty Images)
 It wasn't only her outfit fans adored, as her new haircut bowled them over too. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Instead of her blonde waves, Teri cut her hair into wispy bangs and rock-and-roll, shaggy layers. 
 Teri shared a photo before her big haircut (@ Instagram)
 The darker hue suited her complexion and was in stark contrast to her girl-next-door appearance.
 She shared her makeover on Instagram three weeks before the premiere when she posted before-and-after photos of herself. 
 Teri showed off her edgy new look (@ Getty Images)
 "Thanks for helping my hair and boosting my ego," she wrote alongside a snap of herself with her stylist, Yama. "My forehead wrinkles are miraculously hidden. Who needs Botox! Switch up your hairstyle)." 
 "She looks phenomenal! The bangs and darker tones suit her so well," one admirer gushed, while another added:  "Aging like fine wine — confident, gorgeous, and completely owning her look." 
 Big-screen reunion
 Teri in 2000 (@ Ron Galella Collection via Getty)
 Teri's transformation arrived at an exciting moment in her career, 26-years after she first charmed moviegoers as Pam Byrnes opposite Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro   in the 2000 comedy classic, Meet the Parents. 
 Advertisement Advertisement The actress is reprising her role in the highly anticipated fourth installment.

 In the new chapter, which also welcomes Ariana Grande and Skyler Gisondo to the family fold, Teri and Ben's characters find themselves navigating the hilarious chaos of their grown-up son, Henry, preparing to tie the knot.
 Teri's life away from the spotlight 
 Teri with her daughter (@ Instagram)
 The actress married her first husband, photographer Anthony Moore, in 1997 and they welcome their son, Griffin, in 2002, but divorced in 2005. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Teri met her second long-term partner, Jamie Wollam, who later became the drummer for Tears for Fears, in 2004. The couple share their daughter Bayley, who was born in 2007. They split five years later in 2012. 
 In 2025, she appeared on  The Adam Carolla Show and said she'd found love with a former Marine after meeting him on a dating app. Teri revealed she'd flown to South Korea to meet him for their first date.
